notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (SaaS product teams) evaluating Redwood Hosted API as a quick path to validate features, then moving to Dedicated for EU-residency and predictable latency. Primary contact: CTO (Lea Moreau) + Head of Platform (Ruben Silva).

Discovery notes:
- Team runbook: product chat + semantic search + personalization experiments.
- Latency target: 95th pct < 120ms for user chat sessions inside EU (Frankfurt & Amsterdam preferred).
- Throughput baseline: ~200 rps during peak (bot orchestration + multi-turn chat), burst to 500 for marketing spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Looking for guidance on batching, kv-cache and quantization recommendations.
- Data residency: must keep EU customer data in EU for regulated customers; prefer explicit region pinning. Multi-region routing for DR is acceptable if primary region is EU and replicas are EU only.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 or equivalent, audit logs retention 12+ months, KMS integration for key control.

Activity timeline (recent):
- 2026-01-20: inbound trial signup, product demo (Marcus + Priya).
- 2026-02-02: technical deep-dive with infra (discussed VPC peering, egress requirements). Fireflies: ff_20260302_1623_silkpoint-demo.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted API quick POC completed (initial semantic-search test). Notes: quality good, but EU latency ~180ms 95th when routed to us-east.
- 2026-03-01: Pricing & Dedicated capacity intro call (requested committed capacity pricing for 3x GPU units). Fireflies: ff_20260308_0945_pricing-call.
- 2026-03-08: Security questionnaire submitted; legal kickoff (ticket SEC-2091).
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up on network peering windows and peering IP ranges.

POC plan / asks:
- Short-term: Hosted API used for feature validation and to populate eval datasets (2 weeks).
- Mid-term: Dedicated EU POC (4 weeks) with pinned region (eu-central / eu-west) and controlled fallback to hosted in a secondary EU region for capacity. Measure 95p latency and token cost per 1M tokens.
- Redwood asks: provide Dedicated sizing guidance, example commit tiers, and SAML SSO checklist. Provide a demo of multi-region routing policy and cost/latency tradeoff docs.

Quotes / chatter: "Hosted was fast to get started, but our customer SLAs force us to pin data and avoid cross-region fallbacks to US." — Lea Moreau (CTO).

Next steps (short):
- Marcus to schedule Dedicated POC kickoff week of 2026-03-15.
- Engineering to exchange VPC peering windows + firewall IPs.
- Finance to review committed pricing; Redwood to send formal quote (requested by 2026-03-12).
- Security to review SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration docs (drive link provided).
